caption:
🚂 Slovakia's railways, built at their real dates — 1840 → today.

The network runs east–west along the valleys, squeezed between the Carpathian ridges ⛰️ It starts in 1840 with a horse-drawn line out of Bratislava, and the big burst of the early 1870s is the Košice–Bohumín railway, built while Slovakia was still Upper Hungary.

📊 Data: OpenHistoricalMap (opening and closure dates) + OpenStreetMap (gaps), ODbL. Coverage is uneven, some lines are missing or undated.
🌍 Land: Natural Earth
